newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures dip as rally runs out of impetus.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures dip as rally runs out of impetus.

text.p: LIFFE grains eased Wednesday after several days of rises, traders said.

"It just ran out of steam," one said. May wheat was most active, as old crop positions renewed the initiative, falling 1.25 sterling to 100.75 stg on volume of 169 lots. But November was close behind, with 163 lots. Total wheat volume was 507 lots.

New crop contracts have pulled the market up in recent days amid concern over the possible effects of dry weather on crops in Spain and the UK and worries that next year's supply position might be tighter than expected.
"The market had a good rally, but I think it's a bit overdone," the trader said.
He noted that new crop was weaker than old crop as the rally faded. But there were still signs of underlying support for new crop.
Just 10 lots of barley were traded, all on November, which last changed hands 1.50 stg lower at 96.25 stg. --Christopher Lyddon, London newsroom +44 171 542 7928
